name: Dust Storm
description:
A swirling vortex of sand and dust surrounds you.

Until the start of your next turn, each creature within a 5-space-radius of you (including you) has Total Cover against any creature that is not adjacent to it. Creatures at opposite ends of the dust cloud have Total Cover against each other.

At the start of your turn, you can move each creature other than yourself within the dust cloud by 1 space, as it becomes disoriented by the swirling mass surrounding you.

Each extra success extends the duration by +1 rounds.
